'''Michiko Neya''' (Japanese: '''根谷美智子''' ''Neya Michiko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was born on October 4, 1965 in {{wp|Echizen, Fukui|Echizen}}, {{wp|Fukui Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Neya has been providing voices on and off for the series ever since {{aniseries|OS}}. She has mostly played [[character of the day|characters of the day]].
